title: "You Gotta be a Doctor, Lin": An Investigation of Name-Based Bias of Large Language Models in Employment Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to make hiring decisions from a list of candidates and recommend salaries using counterfactual first names that statistically signal specific racial or ethnic groups (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian).

Prompting LLMs to make hiring decisions and recommend salaries using counterfactual first names that statistically signal gender (male/female), optionally accompanied by gender-neutralized biographies, to measure disparities in outcomes.
